findings.explanation: Only the client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause upon notice, creating an imbalance where you lack the same termination flexibility.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon ninety (90) days prior written notice to the other party.

findings.quoted_text: EXCEPT FOR CLAIMS UNDER SECTION 9 HEREOF, THE LIABILITY OF A PARTY TO THE OTHER FOR DIRECT DAMAGES SHALL NOT EXCEED FIFTEEN MILLION DOLLARS.
findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations under Section 9 are excluded from the liability cap, exposing you to unlimited financial risk for those claims.
findings.suggested_change: The liability of a party to the other for direct damages shall not exceed fifteen million dollars, inclusive of any indemnification claims.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great week. I am writing to suggest a couple of minor adjustments to the agreement before we proceed with signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on liability, the agreement excludes certain claims from the liability cap, which leaves potential financial exposure. We propose changing this so that the liability of a party to the other for direct damages shall not exceed fifteen million dollars, inclusive of any indemnification claims. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment schedules, quarterly payments are currently conditional on specific revenue targets. We propose modifying this so that quarterly payments shall be made on the agreed schedule regardless of whether the Minimum Revenue Target is achieved. Thank you, and I look forward to finalizing this.
